text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in aws-ap-northeast-3. Errors: AWS API 400/InsufficientInstanceCapacity + quota rejections. Queue length on inference-pool has increased x4 in the last 6m. Pager sent to @maya (oncall). Link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/alerts/1987654321

maya (oncall): ACK. I'm looking. grabbing logs and checking autoscaler events.

raj: seeing repeated error from cloud API: 
```
% aws ec2 run-instances --instance-type p4d.24xlarge
An error occurred (InsufficientInstanceCapacity) when calling the RunInstances operation: You requested more capacity than is available.
```
Also quota-metrics show GPUCoreQuota=100 (used=100).

jamie: customer impact summary from frontend: increased 10-25s tails; about 12 customers have intermittent 503/timeouts since ~10:18 UTC. Most traffic is queued, not failing, but latency SLOs breached. CS already notified VIPs.

sre-lead: priority: reduce customer impact first. Maya, plan options: 1) move a subset of traffic to fallback region, 2) pause nonessential batch jobs, 3) attempt smaller instance types or mixed instance policy, 4) open cloud quota case. 

maya (oncall): Plan executing now:
- pausing batch-heavy pipelines on `batch-noncritical` pool (low risk)
- enabling traffic routing rule: 20% -> aws-eu-west-1 fallback pool (route-by:latency+capacity)
- try mixed-instance policy to allow smaller GPUs (a100->t4g?) — will attempt concurrently
- opening support case with AWS and requesting quota bump for ap-northeast-3

cloud-ops: AWS case opened: case# 987654321. Requested GPUs quota increase and clarification on InsufficientInstanceCapacity. AWS initial reply: investigating region capacity; quota increases may take ~1-3 hours. We'll push for priority.

jamie: snippet to route traffic (runbook):
```
redwood route update --policy fallback-apne3 --weights "eu-west-1:0.2,ap-northeast-3:0.8" --dry-run=false
```
I can run this if you want.

maya (oncall): running now.

incident-bot: Deployment event recorded: route update by maya at 1987654380. Auto-scaling events suppressed during manual mitigation.

raj: paused batch pool, `batch-noncritical` downscaled from 40 -> 4 nodes. Jobs requeued to low-priority backlog. That reclaimed ~16 GPUs.

cloud-ops: spun up mixed-instance group with smaller GPUs (g4dn.xlarge equivalents) in ap-northeast-3 to handle lower-memory workloads. Provision attempts succeeded for 8 instances (8 GPUs). Effective capacity +8. Metric update: queue length down 35% after these changes.

jamie: routing change applied. 18% of traffic now going to eu-west-1 fallback. Early indicators: error rate down 60% for affected endpoints. Some increased p95 (about +120ms) for routed requests.

customer-success: messaging sent to impacted customers at 10:42 UTC: "We're mitigating an autoscaling/region capacity issue; some requests may be slower while we shift capacity. We'll follow up with ETA."

sre-lead: Good — keep CS updated. Next: if AWS quota increase not approved in 1hr, escalate to account manager + consider cross-region warm pools.

maya (oncall): manual runbook state:
- actions completed: paused noncritical batch, applied fallback routing, started mixed-instance group, opened support case.
- open actions: monitor queue for 30m, await AWS reply, prepare warm pool in ap-southeast-2 if needed.

peter: i'm taking over at 18:00 PT / handoff in 20m. Any blockers?

maya (oncall): handing off. Summary for night oncall (peter):
- incident root: region capacity exhaustion + InsufficientInstanceCapacity causing autoscaler to stall in aws-ap-northeast-3.
- current impact: degraded latency and intermittent 503s for ~15 customers; overall error rates trending down after mitigations.
- mitigations in place: batch paused, 20% traffic routed to eu-west-1, mixed-instance group active (+8 GPUs), AWS case#987654321 open.
- to-do: monitor queue and error rates, confirm AWS case updates, if queue rises >2x baseline re-run fallback to 40% and start warm pool in ap-southeast-2 (runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/warm-pool).
- commands to run if needed: `redwood pool resize --name warm-apse2 --size 12 --type g4dn.xlarge`

peter: ack. I'll monitor through the night and notify if there's regression.

cloud-ops: AWS updated case at 1987654650: "We can provision capacity in ap-northeast-3 but quota increase is required. We submitted an expedited quota request. Estimated 45-90m."

raj: metrics update at 1987654800: queue length back to 1.2x baseline, p99 latency improving, error rate at 0.4% (from 3.2%). Good stability but still watching.

jamie: created short incident note for status page: "We experienced autoscaler provisioning issues in ap-northeast-3 due to region capacity and account quota limits. Mitigations applied: routing, mixed-instance fallbacks, paused batches. Full update forthcoming."

customer-success: notified affected customers of mitigation and next update window 60m. No escalations so far.

maya (oncall): reassigning follow-ups to cloud-ops for quota escalation and to peter for monitoring. Closing pager for me; handoff complete.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Pager closed for maya at 1987654950. Follow-ups assigned: cloud-ops (quota), peter (monitoring).

peter: will keep a 1h watch and update thread if anything changes. If AWS quota delay >90m we'll trigger cross-region warm pool.

sre-lead: thanks team. Postmortem: please capture timeline, decisions, and why autoscaler couldn't consume spot capacity — add any action items (warm pools, quota pre-checks, autoprov limits) to the postmortem doc.

maya (oncall): noted. I'll draft the incident timeline and initial RCA tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-19876.
